resources.string: Write what only you would write. Over time, a gentle mirror learns your words — reflecting them back with questions, never prescribing what you should do.
Your entries stay in your vault. Export and leave anytime.
AI learns only to understand you better — not to train a public model.
Gentle reminders can be turned off. Mirror tone only: reflect + ask.
Optional. Used only inside your vault.
Write a first page — one sentence is enough.

Author Pro opens 16 vault uploads a day when you need a wider desk.

I’m a mirror grounded in what you’ve written. I’ll reflect and ask — I won’t tell you what to do.
I hear you. Looking at what you already wrote — “%1$s” — it seems something there still matters to you.
I hear you. There isn’t enough in your vault yet for me to reflect specific words back — that’s okay.
What part of that feels closest to how you are right now?

Free, Author Plus, and Author Pro. View plans or restore purchases here. Subscriptions renew through your Google Play account. Signed-in Free vault includes cloud sync.
繁中 / 簡中 / English / 日本語 / ไทย — switch anytime. First launch follows system language (store region).
When on, the mirror may softly surface reflections at relevant moments. Never high-frequency or pushy.
Working provider: xAI Grok. Add XAI_API_KEY (or DIARY_AI_API_KEY) to android/local.properties — defaults BASE_URL https://api.x.ai and model grok-4.7. No secrets in the repo.

Write today for your future self
Sign in to keep your vault yours.
Use your phone number and a one-time SMS code. Signed-in text diaries sync to your account.
That code did not match. Try again.

That code did not match. Debug fixed codes (e.g. 123456) only work if this number is under Firebase Console → Authentication → Phone → Phone numbers for testing. If you removed it to test live SMS, add it back — or enter the real SMS code.

Code mismatch. Firebase project=%1$s error=%2$s. Confirm google-services.json project_id is diaryappsilas (same as Console). Logcat: VaultAuth|FirebasePhoneSMS. Tap resend, or wait for auto sign-in on Debug test numbers.

Firebase is not wired in this Debug APK (project_id blank). On the Windows PC open C:\\dev\\diaryapp\\android\\app\\google-services.json and confirm \"project_id\": \"diaryappsilas\". If the file is missing: Firebase Console → diaryappsilas → Project settings → Android com.diaryvault.app → download google-services.json → save to that path → Sync → uninstall app → Run Debug. Logcat: DiaryVaultFirebase|VaultAuth.
Verification expired. Tap resend, then enter the new code.
Verification session expired (%1$s). Tap resend — Debug should then auto-sign-in for Console test numbers.
Debug test numbers (+85284028001 / +8615014531587) should auto-sign-in after send. If you still see a code field, enter 123456. google-services.json must be project diaryappsilas.
Too many attempts — try again later.
Live SMS needs the Firebase project on the Blaze (pay-as-you-go) plan. Upgrade in Firebase Console, then try again.
SMS isn’t available for this number’s region right now. Try again later or use another number.
Couldn’t finish the security check. Close any browser page that opened, then try again — or use a real phone with Google Play.

Security check needs Google Play or a browser. On emulator: add this number under Firebase Console → Authentication → Phone → Phone numbers for testing and enter the fixed test code, or use a real phone.
The browser security page failed (or Chrome stopped responding). Close that page, return here, and try again. Prefer a real phone with Google Play — emulator Chrome is unreliable.
Request timed out. Close any security browser page if it’s still open, then try again — or use a real phone with Google Play.
Check Messages for the SMS. No text usually means this number is still on Firebase “Phone numbers for testing” (fixed Console code only), or Blaze / SMS region is not ready — then tap Resend.
Verification didn’t finish. Please try sending the code again.
